visualCharacteristics.structure: image + h1 + spec list + pdf pill links + outlined cta

contentPattern: 1 row, 2 cells: [picture: product photo] | [h1 product name; bullet list, one item per spec as 'Label: value' (rendered as a label/value grid); paragraphs with bold links to the PDFs (Package insert, Medication Guide, Download Safety Data Sheet; absolute lupinuscms.azurewebsites.net URLs) rendered as stacked pills; paragraph with italic link 'Download Co-pay Savings Card' -> #copay-terms; paragraph with plain link 'General Terms & Conditions' -> #copay-terms]. Links to a same-page section with class 'modal' open its content in a ; without that section they behave as normal links.
